name: Convergent Currents
introDiscord:
Six distinct currents meet.

One smells faintly of Moonlit Reef.

One carries Starfall dust.

One brings kelp spores.

Another hums like Leviathan's Wake.

Another carries festival confetti.

The sixth is pure Nexus starlight.
introTwitch:
Six distinct currents meet.

One smells faintly of Moonlit Reef.

One carries Starfall dust.

One brings kelp spores.

Another hums like Leviathan's Wake.

Another carries festival confetti.

The sixth is pure Nexus starlight.

convergent-currents-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Convergent Currents.

left.message: A Convergence Elemental forms from all six currents.

right.message:
One Berry floats where the currents meet.

Shizuki wrote:

'Berry visited more regions than some explorers.'

forward.message: A coffer spins through all six waters.

convergent-currents-depths.prompt: Deeper within Convergent Currents, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: The Moonlit and Kelp currents combine into restorative magic.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: An Elemental changes region-themed forms mid-fight.

forward.message: Star Candies tumble from six directions into one cache.

convergent-currents-threshold.prompt: Near Confluence Core, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A chest contains tiny souvenirs from every region.

right.message: The currents briefly become perfectly balanced.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Convergence Elemental guards the Core.

boss-antechamber.name: Confluence Core
boss-antechamber.prompt: Confluence Core begins beating with six different currents at once.

bossPromptDiscord:
Confluence Core begins beating with six different currents at once.

Use /yes to enter or /no to avoid whatever counts as
multi-regional weather.
bossPromptTwitch:
Confluence Core begins beating with six different currents at once.

Use !yes to enter or !no to avoid whatever counts as
multi-regional weather.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Confluence Core. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The six currents twist into one immense living heart.

Sixfold Tideheart reveals itself!

completionText:
The currents separate again.

For the first time, the whole journey feels connected.
